text:
Aisha (partnerships): quick sync — Caldera Systems is handing back EAP tomorrow, need final checklist + benchmark artifacts from eng
Sam (eng-ml): got it. we'll upload model perf CSVs and raw logs to the shared bucket by EOD
Leo (eng-runtime): can you call out which kernels/quant configs we used? ops wants exact compile flags
Sam (eng-ml): current run used `fp16-qat` + `int8-sim` fallback, seq-len 1024, batch sizes in csv
Tom (solutions): vendor asked for a short marketplace readiness blurb — 1–2 lines about supported instance types and throughput
Aisha (partnerships): can legal sign off on the blurb + any NDA constraints? @Marta
Marta (legal): short answer: yes, but remove any comparative claims vs other silicon. Also confirm telemetry opt-in wording
Aisha (partnerships): noted. Sam — add telemetry opt-in text to the README that we'll publish with artifacts
Sam (eng-ml): will add README snippet. also attaching a minimal repro script. gist: `scripts/run_caldera_bench.sh`
edgewave-bot: upload complete: s3://redwood-eap/caldera/1918123456/{perf.csv,logs.tar.gz,readme.md}
Leo (eng-runtime): saw the uploads. two asks: 1) can we get a flamegraph from the profiler? 2) exact driver/kernel versions used
Sam (eng-ml): profiler traces are large — I'll push a 5% sample plus flamegraph.svg to the same bucket
Sam (eng-ml): drivers: `caldera-driver-2.4.1`, runtime-kernel `rkn-3.8.0` (documented in readme)
Tom (solutions): marketplace blurb draft: "Caldera Systems (preview): validated on Caldera D64 nodes. Typical throughput 350–420 tokens/s per replica (fp16) depending on prompt shape."
Marta (legal): tweak: remove "validated" -> "tested"; replace numeric ranges with "~350 tokens/s" to avoid overcommit. Also add: "Customer metrics may vary."
Tom (solutions): updated: "Caldera Systems (preview): tested on Caldera D64 nodes. Typical throughput ~350 tokens/s per replica (fp16); customer metrics may vary.)"
Aisha (partnerships): perfect. final checklist I'm going to paste here — reply with "done" when you complete items

EAP handback checklist (Caldera Systems)
- [ ] Perf CSVs uploaded (s3)
- [ ] Raw logs uploaded (s3)
- [ ] README with telemetry opt-in and driver/kernel versions
- [ ] Repro script present: `scripts/run_caldera_bench.sh`
- [ ] Flamegraph (sample) uploaded
- [ ] Marketplace blurb approved by legal
- [ ] NDA redlines reconciled and signed
- [ ] Partner-facing short summary for joint announcement (1–2 lines)

Sam (eng-ml): done — CSVs, logs, README, repro script, and flamegraph sample uploaded
Leo (eng-runtime): done — driver/kernel versions in README and a short note on compile flags
Marta (legal): done — blurb approved and NDA portal shows signed counterparty
Tom (solutions): done — announcement summary: "Redwood Inference and Caldera Systems announce preview support for Caldera D64, enabling low-latency inference at scale." (ok to use?)
Marta (legal): change "announce" -> "announce a preview of". otherwise ok
Tom (solutions): updated: "Redwood Inference and Caldera Systems announce a preview of support for Caldera D64, enabling low-latency inference at scale."
Aisha (partnerships): great. final party: @edgewave-bot please set ACL on s3 path to `partners-read` and ping vendor for final signoff
edgewave-bot: ACL set. notification sent to contact `partner@caldera.com`
Aisha (partnerships): thanks everyone. I'll coordinate partner signoff and schedule a short demo window tomorrow 11:00 PT. :rocket:
Sam (eng-ml): see you. will keep an eye on the bucket for any follow-up artifacts
Tom (solutions): I'll draft the marketplace listing page and share for a final once we have partner copy
Marta (legal): saving thread notes to NDA folder
Aisha (partnerships): closing thread once partner confirms — tag me if anything else pops up.
